title: Strategic Community Growth Initiative
body: This proposal seeks to leverage our existing ecosystem to unlock synergies across the community stack. Phase one focuses on stakeholder alignment and surfacing the key blockers to sustainable engagement velocity. We will build a framework for onboarding that scales with the movement as it grows. Deliverables to be scoped following discovery.

title: Replacement kettle
body: The kettle died. It makes a noise now and then stops. Everyone is using the one two floors down, which adds ten minutes to every tea. Argos, 34, in stock. I will carry it up myself.

title: 500 vinyl stickers
body: Quote attached from a real printer: 180 for 500 die-cut vinyl, 4 working days. Dave is collecting them Thursday on his way back from the depot.

title: Mobile bike repair — van
body: I have been out of work since January. I want to start a small business doing mobile bike repairs. I have the tools already, they are my own from the last job. 5000 would cover a second-hand van, which is the only thing standing between me and starting.

title: Script to auto-post the ledger
body: Every week somebody copies the week's rulings into the channel by hand. It takes about forty minutes and it gets forgotten. I will write a script that does it on a cron. Priya has agreed to review it. 420 is six hours at my usual rate.

title: Please just read this one properly
body: I have been here since the second week. I have supported this project through everything, including the outage. I am not asking for special treatment, I just think after ten rejections I have earned five minutes of actual consideration. The podcast would promote the meetup, which sells the merch, which funds the podcast.

title: Ergonomic chair, second hand
body: My back is going. There is a refurbished Herman Miller on the local listings for 140, collection only, I can pick it up Saturday. Photo in the listing shows the gas lift works.
